# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We release patches for security vulnerabilities in the following versions:

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 1.x     | ✅        |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take security seriously. If you discover any security related issues, please report them responsibly.

### Preferred reporting method:

Use [GitHub's private security reporting](https://github.com/justbetter/magento2-core/security/advisories/new) to report vulnerabilities privately.

### Alternative method:

Email **security@justbetter.nl** if you prefer not to use GitHub.

All security vulnerabilities will be promptly addressed.

### What to include in your report:

- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- Affected versions
- Possible impact of the vulnerability
- Any suggested fixes (optional)

## Response Timeline

- We aim to acknowledge receipt of your report within 48 hours
- We will provide a more detailed response within 5 business days
- We will work with you to understand and resolve the issue promptly
